svg.title: Chibi Tiny's Total Hero Power guide
svg.desc: Original cropped screenshots show overall power 240,538,823, which is not the requested THP; the correct Hero Power inside Power Details is 159,890,405.
svg.text: Actual game screenshots, with the right number circled
Tap this power to open details.
Use the actual number on your own screen.
"Hi chaos gremlins! Copy the Hero Power
from Power Details, not your overall power.
Let the aliases behave for once!"
